name: Multipass
type_description: OTA-based state-variable filter with HP/LP/BP outputs and distortion
bom_parts_summary: LM13700 OTA, TL074 op-amp, 2N7000/2N3906 transistors, SPST/DPDT switches
components_evidence: BOM lists part numbers and values only (resistors, caps, pots, 2N7000, 2N3906, LM13700, TL074, switches, LEDs, jacks) with no package/mounting designation (no SMD/THT/0805/SOIC/DIP/TO-92 wording found on page).

lineage.quote: Borrowing heavily from a design by Skull & Circuits, Multipass is an OTA-based filter with simultaneous highpass, lowpass and bandpass outputs.

notes: Skull & Circuits credit has no link on the page, so lineage source cannot be confirmed further; no HP or license statement found.
